reviewer: Claude Code agent, while holding every family to the chart-honesty text contract
scope: All 64 family-by-variant cells were compared with the previous approved sheet at native size through a per-pixel difference mask (27,226 of 14,763,840 pixels differ). Only text ink changes: the theme text tones now clear WCAG AA on every surface the theme paints, so muted labels (axis ticks, legend titles, edge and message labels) are slightly darker where the old tone missed AA on a tinted surface, and labels drawn over lines or data carry a halo in the surface beneath them. Geometry, typography, containment, endpoints, peer-category paint, and authored emphasis are unchanged in every cell.
